cohort: 310 patients with placenta previa (269 in the training cohort from the Second Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University and 41 in the validation cohort from Quanzhou Children's Hospital)
finding: A nomogram model based on MRI findings (type-II placental bulge, placenta covering the scar, and placental protrusion sign) and the clinical characteristic of having had two or more previous cesarean sections was found to be highly accurate for predicting invasive placenta in women with placenta previa.
